"'''Three Eyes'''" was the nickname given to a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] by his [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Vette]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] child he owned during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Three Eyes acquired Vette around [[3656 BBY]], but not long afterwards he crossed the more powerful crime lord [[Nok Drayen]] and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] as a result.
